description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseAudioMixer' for implementing audio mixers in a software project. The class provides method signatures for starting, stopping, processing control frames, and mixing audio streams, meant to be subclassed for specific mixer implementations.

classes.name: BaseAudioMixer
classes.description: Abstract base class for output transport audio mixers, defining the interface for initializing, stopping, processing control frames, and mixing audio data.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Initializes the mixer with the output transport's sample rate when the transport starts.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the output transport stops.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: MixerControlFrame)
methods.description: Processes mixer control frames received from the transport.

methods.name: bytes mix(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Mixes provided transport audio with the mixer-generated audio, returning the combined audio bytes.

ctags.name: mix
ctags.pattern: /^    async def mix(self, audio: bytes) -> bytes:$/
